generation.prompt:
A pixel-art character reference sheet for a game, redrawing one existing character in a simple, clean, bright style.

Image 1 is the STYLE and SCALE target, the sheet to match exactly: the size of its figures, its pixel size, its simple big shapes, its flat clean colour clusters, its clean dark outline, its proportions, its flat dark navy background (#1a2230), its layout of four views side by side. Do not copy its characters.
Image 2 is the CHARACTER to redraw, keeping who she is: a slim young woman duelist with long purple hair in a high ponytail, but brighter and with far less detail.

Layout: one single character at the top left of the image, four views side by side, in this order: front, three-quarter front, back, left profile, exactly as in image 1. The rest of the image is empty background. No text, no labels, no frame, no ground shadow.

Colours: she must read clearly on a dark background and on grey stone. Bright lavender and violet tunic with a short violet cape, an ivory shirt, warm skin on the arms and legs, tan leather boots and gloves, a tan belt. No black clothing. Long bright purple hair with lighter highlights. A clear face with two large matching eyes.

Important: plain cloth. NO emblems, NO symbols, NO embroidery. Nothing held in the hands. Calm standing pose, arms slightly away from the body. Real pixel art on one regular grid, no blur, no gradient, no dithering.
